agents.answer:
The pizza order was submitted and httpbin.org accepted it. The response page echoes the form data back as:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese (httpbin lists them as `bacon` and `cheese`)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

Another agent navigated my first tab away from the form partway through, so I opened my own tab and finished there. I filled the form with a script rather than typing into each field, then clicked the submit button. The result page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) is still open in that tab. I didn't touch the other agents' tabs.

tool_input.command: S="$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task)"; echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

The order is complete. After checking out as Ada Lovelace (postal code 10001), the site showed "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

- I logged in as standard_user and sorted the products by Price (low to high).
- I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light, and the cart showed those two items.
- The final page, `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html`, is still open in my own tab (t2), which I did not close.

Other agents kept switching the active tab, so one of my early clicks didn't register and I re-checked the cart before adding items. I worked only in the tab I opened.
